districts.name: QUANTUM TRANSPORT & SOLID-STATE PHYSICS
districts.description: Resolving transport mechanisms: VRH vs SCLC, contact barrier gating, and statistical null-hypothesis testing in novel semiconductors.

districts.name: AUTONOMOUS AI SCIENTIST & ACTIVE EXPERIMENTATION
districts.description: Agentic discovery pipelines, Bayesian active learning, automated experiment design, and autonomous tool manipulation.

districts.name: IN-MEMORY COMPUTING & ANALOG CROSSBARS
districts.description: Analog vector-matrix multipliers, non-volatile resistive switching, energy-efficient neuromorphic inference cores.

districts.name: 2D HETEROSTRUCTURES & ATOM-THIN INTERFACES
districts.description: Graphene/hBN/TMD van der Waals heterostructures, twistronics, and defect engineering for non-volatile synapses.

districts.name: INTEGRATED NEUROMORPHIC FOUNDRY & SCALE-UP
districts.description: Back-end-of-line (BEOL) CMOS integration, 200mm wafer yield optimization, and cyber-physical packaging.

spires.title: SCLC Null-Hypothesis Spire
spires.abstract: Conclusively settled the mechanism debate, proving Space-Charge-Limited Current (SCLC) exponent m=2.71 and isolating the 20% contact barrier modulation threshold.

spires.title: Agentic Experiment Designer
spires.abstract: Autonomous agent proposing targeted experimental sweeps, orchestrating physical measurement instruments, and eliminating human confirmation bias.

spires.title: Analog Crossbar Accelerator
spires.abstract: In-memory analog matrix acceleration utilizing conductance states of 2D memristive devices, performing single-cycle analog vector dot products.

spires.title: Van der Waals Robotic Stacker
spires.abstract: Robotic pick-and-place assembly of pristine 2D atomic monolayers with controlled twist angle and sub-nanometer interface cleanliness.

spires.title: CMOS-Compatible Wafer Pilot Line
spires.abstract: Integration of 2D memristive selector arrays onto industrial CMOS wafer back-end metallization layers.

bottlenecks.title: The Physical World Rate-Limiter
bottlenecks.impact: The agent designed the crucial settling experiment; fabrication was declined on capacity grounds. A loop whose slowest step is human partner scheduling cannot be accelerated with better models.
bottlenecks.remedy: Decentralized on-demand micro-foundry access and multi-site fabrication agreements.

bottlenecks.title: Sparse & Uneven Experimental Data
bottlenecks.impact: Temperature was varied at one device size only; temperature and geometry cannot be separated. No amount of AI modelling fixes a missing physical axis.
bottlenecks.remedy: Enforce orthogonal experimental matrix requirements before active learning initiates.

bottlenecks.title: Irreversible Metadata Loss
bottlenecks.impact: For an entire batch of samples one geometric parameter was never recorded. Those measurements can never be converted into intrinsic material properties by anyone.
bottlenecks.remedy: Automated cryptographic provenance tracking directly at instrument data capture.

challenges.title: Attribution Challenge: Evaluating the Agent
challenges.target: Develop rigorous double-blind benchmarks to prove the AI agent was the true cause of discovery, rather than a well-equipped human using the same tools.

challenges.title: 2D Defect Scaling to 200mm Wafers
challenges.target: Achieve wafer-scale uniformity of 2D film conductance with defect density under 1 defect per square micron.

conduits.name: Physics Transport Prior Conduit
conduits.description: Transfers verified physical transport models into the agent's prior distribution to avoid degenerate parameter sweeps.

conduits.name: Crossbar Synthesis Dispatch
conduits.description: Dispatches optimized device biasing and pulse-width modulation sequences into the neuromorphic crossbar.
